paragraphs: Rav Ammi. Huna asked him, Bava Batra 11b [the checked Bavli reads Rabbi Ammi, while Tosafot’s heading reads Rav Ammi]. Tosafot: Rabbi Ammi was subordinate to Huna; Rabbi Ammi and Rav Ammi may be distinct.
Since errors commonly confuse Rabbi Ammi and Rav Ammi, I shall arrange alphabetically, for understanding.

Abba, his student (see there); Abba bar Mammal asked him; Abba of Haifa in his house. He asked Abba bar Zavda. Abbahu, his colleague. Rav Avya in his name; Avya the elder before him. Rav Oshaya asked him, Pesachim 63b; Jerusalem Talmud, Kirah 1: “Often I sat before Hoshaya.” Acha Sar Habbirah before him; Acha bar Chanina in his name; Acha bar Pappa; Achai; Ila in his name. In Rabbi Elazar’s name. Rabbi Ammi bar Avin, Ammi Vardina'ah, Ammi bar Natan in his time. Ashyan asked him. Rav Bibi bar Avin; Birim in his name; Bira; Binyamin bar Levi; bar Hedya; Berekhiah. Rav Dimi and Daniel bar Ketina in his name. Zeira found him reporting Ze'ira; Zerika in his name. Chiyya of Sepphoris objected to him. Rabbi Ammi called Chiyya bar Abba “master.” Chanina bar Pappi. In Chanina’s name, Bava Batra 130b. Chisda (see there). Yehudah Nesia asked him. In Yehoshua ben Levi’s name, Berakhot 3b; Bamidbar Rabbah 5. Rabbi Yochanan, his teacher (see there). Yonah, his father-in-law, Yonah reports in Rabbi Ammi’s name, Chagigah 24b; Yannai, his father-in-law (see there); Yannai bar Ammi the priest. Yaakov Gevulaya in his name. Yitzchak Nappacha disputes with him. He spoke to Yitzchak, his colleague; Yitzchak Tavola. He sent to Yitzchak bar Chaluv. Yitzchak bar Bisna called him teacher. Yitzchak bar Haifa, Yitzchak bar Ashyan, and Yitzchak bar Redifa, his students. Yishmael of Kefar Yamma before him. La in his name; Levi Tzanberaya asked him. Mallukh the Arabian in his time. Menachem bar Mevasimo and Menachem in his name. Rav Nachman bar Shmuel bar Nachman before him; Nachman bar Yitzchak apparently contemporary, Shabbat 119a. Simon in Rabbi Ammi’s name; Rav Safra in his name. He was offended with Anani bar Sasson. Perida asked him. Rabbah and Rabbah bar bar Chana in his name; he stood before Rabbi Assi and Rav Ammi. In Shammai’s name. Rav Ammi in Resh Lakish’s name, Berakhot 53b; Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 1, end of first passage; Ma'aserot 1:1; Kirah. Chagigah 24b: apparently Rabbi Ammi in Resh Lakish’s name. Rabbi Ammi in Resh Lakish’s name, Shekalim, chapter 1.
